gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the battery-hour ratings on these boards are not on one basis: dividing capacity by rated hours gives about 3 mA of implied draw for the NuPhy Node75 low-profile (3,000 mAh, 'up to 1,000 hours', no conditions given) against about 20 mA for the Keychron K3 Max (1,550 mAh, 78 h backlight off) and 25 mA for the Lofree Flow Lite 84 (2,000 mAh, about 80 h lighting off), and that the Node75 drops from 1,000 Hz to 125 Hz on Bluetooth.
standout_why: Compared against pcreviewer.org (cited), kbdcompare.com (cited), the keeb-finder K3 Max comparison and the RTINGS list (body did not load). pcreviewer lists battery hours board by board and has backlight-on versus off for the K3 Pro only; it never puts the brands on one basis and does not cover the Node75. kbdcompare gives 4,000 mAh / 1,200 h for the Air75 V3 with no conditions and K3 Pro figures (100 h / 50 h) that contradict pcreviewer's (130 h / 68 h). keeb-finder gives mAh only and no per-mode polling. Two cited pages could not be opened (technobezz.com 403, purchase.fyi certificate error), so this is not checked against them. Caveat: Keychron, Lofree and NuPhy stores returned HTTP 429 on every attempt, so the K3 Max and Flow Lite figures are the maker ratings as quoted by pcreviewer.org; they need a maker-page re-read before publishing. The height half of this angle scores 1: pcreviewer already has the K3 Pro's 15 mm without keycaps versus 22 mm with.
decides: It confirms rather than changes the pick. The Node75's 1,000-hour claim should not be read as 12 times the K3 Max's 78 hours, so battery is not a reason to choose it over the K3 Max or a Lofree Flow Lite; anyone using Bluetooth on the Node75 gets 125 Hz. On height, the boards with a stated with-keycaps figure sit within 1.5 mm of each other (K3 Max 22 mm rear, Logitech G515 22 mm, Flow Lite 84 23.5 mm), so 'thinnest' does not separate them either; the 14 to 15 mm figures quoted elsewhere are a different basis. That leaves price, layout, remapping and switch feel to decide. Our row that fits the budget on its own terms is the Lofree Flow Lite 2 84 ($87.20 at checkout per the brief); the original Flow Lite84 ChatGPT showed at $99.99 is $79.20 at Lofree's checkout per the brief's partner table.
